people.name: Canaan
people.line: Ancient region; descendants of Ham; promised to Abraham's descendants

people.name: Gad
people.line: Israelite tribe; descended from Gad, son of Jacob.

people.name: Gilgal
people.line: A significant site during Israel's early history in Canaan.

people.name: Jordan
people.line: A river and region, significant in Israel's history

people.name: Manasseh
people.line: Firstborn son of Joseph, blessed by Jacob.

people.name: Reuben
people.line: Firstborn son of Jacob and Leah

translations.web: When they came to the region near the Jordan, that is in the land of Canaan, the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh built an altar there by the Jordan, a great altar to look at.
translations.bsb: And when they came to Geliloth near the Jordan in the land of Canaan, the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh built an imposing altar there by the Jordan.
translations.kjv: And when they came unto the borders of Jordan, that are in the land of Canaan, the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh built there an altar by Jordan, a great altar to see to.
translations.asv: And when they came unto the region about the Jordan, that is in the land of Canaan, the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh built there an altar by the Jordan, a great altar to look upon.
